# Vitaheal — Tasks

## Template Info

- **New Name:** Vitaheal
- **Original:** ColorLib Health (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/health/)
- **Preview:** https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/health/
- **Category:** Medical / Healthcare

## Design Tokens

- Primary green: #32c69a
- Coral accent: #ffa07f / #FF6347
- Body text: #a5a5a5, #929191
- Heading text: #404040, #4c4c4c
- Font: Montserrat (Google Fonts)
- Background: #FFFFFF

## Sections

1. Header (top bar + sticky nav)
2. Hero (background image, headline, CTA)
3. Info Boxes (3-col: consultations, emergency, appointment form)
4. CTA Banner (parallax, appointment prompt)
5. Services (6 icon boxes in 3-col grid)
6. Departments (horizontal scroll cards)
7. FAQ accordion + Latest News
8. Footer (about, contact form, hours, bottom bar with Component Dock)
